info.title: zorg-pdf: render Zorg.Pdf JSON documents, or Markdown, to tagged PDF.
info.description: The zorg-pdf command-line tool: render Zorg.Pdf JSON documents and Markdown to tagged PDF, validate them, and render again on every save.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Take some pages out, or rewrite with new metadata

options.name: --output
options.description: Where the PDF goes; "-" for standard output. Default: the document's name with .pdf

options.name: --data
options.description: Table rows, images and the template model

options.name: --image
options.description:
An image, a PDF for a background or an attachment, for a data slot;
repeatable. --file is the same

options.name: --fonts
options.description: Use the TrueType fonts in a folder; repeatable

options.name: --font
options.description: Use a font file; repeatable

options.name: --default-font
options.description: The family for text whose style names none

options.name: --system-fonts
options.description: Also use installed fonts. On when no --fonts or --font is given

options.name: --pdfua
options.description: Claim PDF/UA-1 and treat accessibility warnings as errors

options.name: --pdfa
options.description:
Claim PDF/A for archiving (sRGB output intent, no CMYK images);
3 allows attachments

options.name: --warnaserror
options.description: Exit with 1 when there are warnings

options.name: --json
options.description: Print results as JSON, one object per line

options.name: --preview
options.description: With render and watch: also draw pages as PNG beside the PDF

options.name: --page
options.description: The page to draw, from 1 (default 1), or all

options.name: --pages
options.description: extract: the pages to take; merge takes file.pdf:1-3

options.name: --facturx
options.description: render: embed a Factur-X/ZUGFeRD CII XML (and claim PDF/A-3)

options.name: --keywords
options.description: merge and extract: new metadata (default: the first file's)

options.name: --dpi
options.description: The PNG's resolution, 18 to 600 (default 96)

options.name: --certificate
options.description:
sign: the signer's certificate and key. Its password is read from the
ZORG_PDF_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD environment variable, never the command line

options.name: --field
options.description: sign: the empty signature field to sign (default Signature1, added if missing)

options.name: --location
options.description: sign: shown with the signature

options.name: --timestamp
options.description:
sign: a timestamp authority, for a PAdES B-T signature
(sign also takes --font for the text drawn into the field)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Also print information, such as images that were shrunk

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version
A document ending in .md or .markdown is read as Markdown; its images are read from beside it, or
given with --image. A document of "-" is read from standard input. Exit codes: 0 done, 1 problems in the document or its
data, 2 a wrong command line or a file that couldn't be read or written.
